description: The Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-23MS is a single-seat fighter based on the MiG-23MF. It has the older RP-22SM radar and other avionics are degraded. The NATO reporting name for the aircraft is Flogger-F and for the radar is Jay Bird.
loadnotes: May use special jettisonable 800L FTs (1,730 lb, 3.5/2.0 load points, and 73 fuel points). When carrying FTs, must remain below low transonic speed. When carrying FTs on the wing stations 1 and 9, the wings must remain forward.
May use: R-3R (AA-2 Atoll) RHMs and R-3S and R-13M (AA-2 Atoll) RHMs.
May use: FAB-100/250/500 BBs, ZAB-500 incendiary BBs, and RBK-500 cluster BBs; UB-16-57 RPs; S-24 RKs; and Kh-23 (AS-7 Kerry) RGs.
